projectContext.description: voiceover-matcher-subtitle: AI-powered pipeline for matching voiceover to stock footage

userStories.title: Generate sprint stories for download focus area
acceptanceCriteria: Read scripts/ralph/config/ralph-config.json to understand the 'download' focus area
Read scripts/ralph/session/prompt.md for project context and architecture notes
Read scripts/ralph/state/queue.json for interview details (story outline, architecture decisions, key files)
Read CLAUDE.md for project conventions and known issues
Analyze the codebase to find 8-12 specific improvements for 'download'
Add stories US-61-002 through US-61-012 to scripts/ralph/state/prd.json (MUST use sprint-prefixed IDs)
Each story MUST have 4-6 testable acceptance criteria
Each story MUST have a 'notes' field with: (1) tier classification, (2) exact source file paths, (3) line number ranges if removing/moving code
IMPORTANT: All generated stories MUST have passes set to false - do NOT run tests or evaluate whether they already pass
IMPORTANT: Story IDs MUST follow format US-61-NNN to be unique across sprints
Mark this story (US-61-001) as passes: true when done
userStories.notes: Generated 10 stories (US-61-002 through US-61-011) for download focus area based on user interview notes about caption format fallback issues and codebase analysis of yt-dlp integration, circuit breaker, escalation manager, cookie rotation, and VPN fallback systems.

userStories.title: Add subtitle availability pre-check before caption format cycling
acceptanceCriteria: In CaptionFetcher._fetch_subtitle(), add call to list_available_subtitles() before trying format fallback loop
If no subtitles available (has_any_subtitles=False), return CaptionUnavailableError immediately without cycling formats
Log the fast-fail path at DEBUG level with 'Caption fast-fail: no subtitles for {video_id}'
Reduce worst-case time from ~40s (4 format attempts) to ~10s (1 list-subs call) for captionless videos
Add test verifying captionless video triggers fast-fail path and only invokes 1 subprocess
userStories.notes: Complete. Pre-flight list-subs check was implemented in US-59-002 and US-60-005. Added DEBUG log line 'Caption fast-fail: no subtitles for {video_id}' at line 4483. Test test_no_captions_triggers_single_ytdlp_call verifies only 1 subprocess call. All 12 tests in test_caption_preflight.py pass.

userStories.title: Add caption circuit breaker integration with download circuit breaker
acceptanceCriteria: Add shared CircuitBreakerState reference between CaptionCircuitBreaker and download CircuitBreaker
When caption circuit breaker trips, increment shared failure counter to speed download circuit breaker trip
When download circuit breaker trips on 403/429, propagate pause state to caption fetcher
Add circuit_breaker_cascade config option to enable/disable this behavior (default: true)
Add test verifying caption CB trip affects download CB state and vice versa
userStories.notes: Complete. Implementation in src/caption/circuit_breaker.py and src/downloader/circuit_breaker.py with set_download_circuit_breaker()/set_caption_circuit_breaker() linking, _cascade_failure_to_*() and _cascade_trip_to_*() propagation methods. Config sections updated with circuit_breaker_cascade option. Comprehensive tests in tests/test_circuit_breaker_cascade.py (26 tests) verifying bidirectional failure/trip propagation, config options, and edge cases. All tests pass.

userStories.title: Add per-video download speed tracking for adaptive timeout
acceptanceCriteria: Track bytes/second download speed in DownloadSpeedTracker for each video
Calculate running average speed across last N downloads (configurable, default 10)
Add adaptive_timeout calculation: estimated_size / avg_speed * safety_factor (default 1.5)
Replace static DEFAULT_SEGMENT_TIMEOUT with adaptive timeout when speed data available
Add test verifying timeout scales with observed download speed
userStories.notes: Complete. Added calculate_adaptive_timeout() method to DownloadSpeedTracker using formula: estimated_size / avg_speed * safety_factor. Updated window_size default to 10 for running average. Added safety_factor config (default 1.5). Wired adaptive timeout into download_video_segments in audio_first.py. Added 10 comprehensive tests in TestCalculateAdaptiveTimeout class including test_timeout_scales_with_observed_speed verifying fast networks get shorter timeouts and slow networks get proportionally longer timeouts.

userStories.title: Add impersonation target success rate tracking
acceptanceCriteria: In ImpersonationStats, add success_count and failure_count per target
Add record_success(target) and record_failure(target) methods
Calculate success_rate per target: success / (success + failure)
In get_next_target(), optionally skip targets with success_rate < threshold (default 0.2)
Add test verifying low-success targets are deprioritized in rotation
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (enhancement). Files: src/downloader/impersonation.py (ImpersonationStats class at line ~25, ImpersonationManager). Currently targets rotate round-robin without considering which targets actually work - some targets may consistently fail while others succeed.

userStories.title: Add escalation tier de-escalation on sustained success
acceptanceCriteria: Add consecutive_successes counter to EscalationState dataclass
In record_success(), increment consecutive_successes and check de-escalation threshold
If consecutive_successes >= de_escalation_threshold (default 5), decrease tier by 1
Add de_escalation_enabled config option (default: true)
Add test verifying 5 consecutive successes at Tier 3 drops to Tier 2
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (enhancement). Files: src/downloader/escalation_manager.py (EscalationState at line ~27, record_success method), src/downloader/types.py (EscalationState/EscalationTier). Currently escalation is sticky per-session - once at Tier 3, stays there even if YouTube stops blocking.

userStories.title: Add caption fetch error category metrics
acceptanceCriteria: Add error_counts dict to CaptionMetrics tracking counts per CaptionErrorCategory
In categorize_caption_error(), increment the appropriate category counter
Add summary logging at batch end: 'Caption errors by category: RATE_LIMIT=5, UNAVAILABLE=12...'
Expose error_counts in get_performance_summary() for dashboard integration
Add test verifying error categorization increments correct counter
userStories.notes: Tier 3 (observability). Files: src/caption_fetcher.py (CaptionMetrics class), src/caption/error_handling.py (categorize_caption_error), src/caption/enums.py (CaptionErrorCategory). Currently caption errors are logged individually but not aggregated by category for diagnosis.

userStories.title: Add cookie rotation on caption 403 errors
acceptanceCriteria: In CaptionFetcher, accept optional CookieRotator instance in constructor
On caption 403/rate-limit error, call cookie_rotator.should_rotate() and rotate if true
Pass rotated cookie path to yt-dlp subprocess via --cookies flag
Log cookie rotation attempts: 'Caption fetch rotating cookie after 403'
Add test verifying 403 error triggers cookie rotation and retry
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (core functionality). Files: src/caption_fetcher.py (CaptionFetcher.__init__ and _fetch_subtitle), src/downloader/cookie_rotator.py. Currently caption fetcher does not use cookie rotation even though download core.py does - caption 403s exhaust retries without trying alternate cookies.

userStories.title: Add download segment progress callback
acceptanceCriteria: Add progress_callback parameter to AudioFirstPipeline.download_segment()
Parse yt-dlp progress output (% complete, bytes downloaded, speed) from stderr
Call progress_callback(video_id, percent, bytes_downloaded, speed) on each progress line
Add default no-op callback to maintain backward compatibility
Add test verifying progress callback receives expected values during download
userStories.notes: Tier 3 (UX enhancement). Files: src/downloader/audio_first.py (download_segment at line ~427). Currently segment downloads show no progress - users see no feedback during long downloads.

userStories.title: Add rate limit budget summary to download completion log
acceptanceCriteria: At end of download_all(), log RateLimitBudget summary: rotations used, VPN switches, total backoff time
Include percentage of budget consumed: 'Budget used: rotations 3/10 (30%), backoff 45s/300s (15%)'
Log keywords that triggered rate limit events from keywords_rate_limited list
Add budget_summary() method to RateLimitBudget returning formatted string
Add test verifying budget summary reflects actual usage
userStories.notes: Tier 3 (observability). Files: src/downloader/rate_limit_budget.py (RateLimitBudget class), src/downloader/core.py (download_all). Currently budget state is tracked internally but not summarized at completion for user visibility.

userStories.title: Add VPN rotation trigger on caption budget exhaustion
acceptanceCriteria: When CaptionRetryBudget exhausts with >50% RATE_LIMIT errors, trigger MullvadVPN rotation
After VPN rotation, reset caption retry budget and retry remaining videos
Add vpn_rotation_on_caption_exhaustion config option (default: false, requires mullvad.enabled)
Log VPN rotation: 'Caption budget exhausted (80% rate-limited), rotating VPN and retrying'
Add test verifying VPN rotation triggers on caption budget exhaustion with rate limits
userStories.notes: Tier 2 (integration). Files: src/caption_fetcher.py, src/caption/retry_budget.py (BatchRetryBudget), src/downloader/mullvad_vpn.py, src/config/sections/download.py. Currently caption budget exhaustion just skips remaining videos - it should try VPN rotation first if rate-limited.
